title: Théorie arithmétique. Théorie de Galois des motifs (1965) : notes manuscites (s.d.), tapuscrit (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page has nothing to do with motives or Tannakian categories. It is a typed page numbered '- 9 -', filed upside down: a verso or scrap sheet from a typed text, probably a Bourbaki-style or course draft, on elementary analytic function theory over K = R or C with values in a normed (Banach) space E. Grothendieck habitually wrote on the backs of such drafts. The handwritten '56' / '95' are archive or folio numbers.

The mathematics:
(1) The page ends the statement of a composition theorem for power series. Substituting power series g_k(u_1..u_q) for z_k in f, and then series in v for u, gives the same result as composing directly.
(2) Section 4, 'La notion de fonction holomorphe', starts with Proposition 4, the re-centering theorem. Let f = Σ c_n z^n be absolutely summable in the open polydisc |z_k| < r_k, and let a be a point of the polydisc. For |u_k| < r_k − |a_k|, substituting a_k + u_k for z_k gives an absolutely summable series in u whose sum is f(a+u). The proof applies the earlier Theorem 2 (the substitution criterion with majorant h_k(|u|) = |a_k| + |u_k| < r_k).
(3) Definition 2: f : A → E, with A open in K^p, is holomorphic if it is locally the sum of an absolutely summable power series in z − a.
(4) Proposition 5 begins: a power series summable in an open polydisc centred at 0 is holomorphic there.

This is the classical Weierstrass re-expansion principle. It serves only to set up the definition of analytic functions of several variables.

ideas.what: Re-centering (re-expansion) of a convergent multivariable power series at any interior point of its polydisc of convergence, and the definition of holomorphic/analytic functions as locally sums of power series
ideas.modern_name: Analyticity of power series inside polydisc of convergence; Weierstrass definition of analytic functions
ideas.usually_credited_to: Weierstrass (19th c.); standard textbook material (e.g. H. Cartan, Bourbaki Variétés différentielles et analytiques, Fascicule de résultats)
ideas.where_published: Not a Grothendieck text; standard in Cartan's 'Théorie élémentaire des fonctions analytiques' and Bourbaki drafts

ideas.what: Composition/substitution of power series (end of preceding theorem)
ideas.modern_name: Associativity of substitution of formal/convergent power series
